svg.title: Engineering reference - source page 83
svg.desc: Four high-intensity jet and ten massage positions. P2.5 LED displays surrounding four sides excluding the entrance; refresh >3840 Hz; height 2.5 m. Eight wind groups, rainfall and simulated lightning. Integrated control synchronised with a four-minute 4K storm film; waterproof audio and pipework. Final scope follows the chosen design.
